items.title: Properties and uniqueness of the injective hull of a module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects two elementary properties and three uniqueness statements for the injective hull of a module (author lemma at source lines 718-740, label lemma-injective-hull-unique). The proof (source lines 742-757) obtains the first two by extending the identity and killing the kernel by essentialness, and derives the uniqueness statements by splitting the target along the image and killing the complement by essentialness, repeating the argument in the last clause (proof lines 742-756). The splitting argument is the substance. H3.
